title: Late Breaking Results: Warpage-Aware Generative Floorplanning for Reliable Advanced Packaging
problem: Advanced IC packaging introduces heterogeneous materials and dense interconnects, causing thermal warpage that degrades system performance and reliability during floorplanning optimization.
motivation: Warpage is a primary reliability concern in advanced packaging, yet conventional floorplanning algorithms do not explicitly model or optimize for warpage effects.
method: A neural network called a transformer learns how chip components relate to and connect with each other (nodes and edges in a floorplan graph). It then generates improved component arrangements in parallel while simultaneously checking for and correcting thermal warpage—the material distortion that occurs when different materials in densely packed advanced packaging heat unevenly. The method jointly minimizes component displacement and warpage by directly incorporating thermal-mechanical coupling constraints (understanding how materials actually bend under heat) into the optimization.
key_novelty: This is the first method to use a transformer neural network to automatically design chip layouts while jointly minimizing component displacement and thermal warpage—the material distortion from uneven heating in advanced IC packaging.
contributions: Novel transformer-based encoding scheme for floorplan graph representations
Integrated warpage-mechanical constraint modeling in legalization
9.9% average warpage improvement and 8.3% wirelength reduction over state-of-the-art
primary_theme: Warpage-aware AI-guided floorplanning for advanced packaging reliability
